name: Audit Published Content Defects
summary: Find visible markdown, placeholders, and broken text on published pages, grouped by kind.
description: Find the defects a reader can see on published web pages, such as markdown left visible, unresolved placeholders, double-escaped entities, paragraphs cut after an abbreviation, repeated paragraphs, and passages left untranslated, across one page, a sitemap, or saved HTML, and report them grouped by kind with examples as JSON, Markdown, or HTML. Use when generated, templated, or translated content needs a check before readers notice, not to judge style or rewrite pages.
risk_reason: This skill reads public pages or saved HTML one at a time with a pause and a named user agent, stops when a site blocks it, and writes only a local report.
refuses: It does not judge writing quality, tone, or whether a text was written with AI.
It does not edit pages, content, or code; it reports what it finds.
It does not evade bot protection or rate limits, or audit sites the user cannot authorize.

entrypoints.purpose: Fetch a page, a sitemap, or saved HTML, find visible rendering defects, and write JSON, Markdown, or HTML reports.

operational.latency_reason: The helper fetches pages sequentially with a fixed pause, caps a run at 5,000 pages, and stops after three bot checks in a row.
